claim: Upper Missouri River Breaks National Monument: Establishment of the Upper Missouri River Breaks National Monument (2001-01-17). This was a presidential proclamation (Proclamation 7398, 66 FR 7359). The President in office that day was Bill Clinton.

indexText: Vermilion Cliffs National Monument
claim: Vermilion Cliffs National Monument: Vermilion Cliffs National Monument (2000-11-09). This was a presidential proclamation (Proclamation 7374, 65 FR 69227). The President in office that day was Bill Clinton.
note: Title names the monument only; read the proclamation to describe what it changed.
